chunks: As often as they try to escape from its anguish they would be put back into (the fire), and taste the torment of burning.
ai.seo_question: What happens when the inhabitants of Hell try to escape its fire?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hajj illustrates the psychological torment of the disbelievers, where the fleeting hope of escape is immediately crushed by the certainty of return, emphasizing the finality of divine decree. The 'burning' (al-hariq) is interpreted not merely as physical pain but as the intense heat of regret and the consuming fire of their own rejected truths. This cyclical punishment serves as a warning against the arrogance of those who believe they can outwit God's justice.
